mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising employment (PAYEMS) and declining housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing sector that is not supported by the labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and HOUST decreases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.5% monthly), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, reducing corporate sales and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average indicates a weakening supply chain, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline.
